Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the provided approved four-frame walking/running sprite sheet to produce its LEFT-facing counterpart.
There are EXACTLY four columns and two rows. Every pose is approved. Top row walks, bottom row runs.
Task: horizontally reflect EACH CHARACTER WITHIN ITS OWN CELL so she faces LEFT, preserving the columns in their original order. Do NOT flip the whole sheet and reverse the frame order.
Preserve the exact mirrored geometry of every leg, shoe, arm, dress, face and hair in each frame. The motion must be identical to the approved right-facing cycle, just directed left. Do not invent, reinterpret or improve the poses. Do not add new drawings. Preserve the consistent pixel art, child proportions, existing shading, same size and registration.
The ONLY change beyond reflection is wing color: the large viewer-facing feather wing that was WHITE must become BLACK/dark charcoal with readable feather shading; the smaller far wing that was BLACK must become WHITE with pale grey shading. Keep the shapes, contours and positions of those wings. Never recolor the white hair, the white sleeves, dress or socks. Anatomical LEFT wing stays black, anatomical RIGHT wing stays white; in these left-facing sprites the near wing is BLACK.
Character is Yuuki, child age 9, white hair, red eyes, black-and-white modest dress, no weapons, no halo.
Preserve true transparent background and transparent gutters. No blur, no added fragments, no labels, no drop shadows. Exactly eight complete sprites: four mirrored approved walk poses in the same order, then four mirrored approved run poses in the same order. All shoes remain fully visible. Matching the approved feet and leg motion is the highest priority.
